messages:
Noah Rivera: Quick thought: our postmortem follow-ups need a lightweight enforcement layer. Proposal: a two-part change - (1) a compact remediation block that is machine-parseable and includes an automated smoke-test link, and (2) a shadow handoff day for the IC rotation so knowledge isn't stove-piped. Short conv?

Sofia Martinez: love the shadow-day idea. too many handoffs are just verbal. a mandatory one-pager plus a short checklist would help. for the remediation block, keep fields strict: owner, due, failure_mode, smoke_check, checkpoints, prevented_by.

Akash Verma: for checkpoints, i'd prefer 36h/5d/21d. 36h catches immediate slippage, 5d forces a short triage and 21d verifies no regression. ops-bot can schedule reminders and escalate into the remediation board automatically.

Mira Collins: add a field: verification:type = automated/manual. dashboard can then surface which items still need human validation. Also recommend a business-impact flag so product managers get pulled in for high-impact regressions.

Noah Rivera: example block to paste into a postmortem or ticket (single block, easy to parse):

```
remediation: "Short summary"
owner: "Name (team)"
due: "YYYY-MM-DD"
failure_mode: [auth, cache, infra-deg]
smoke_check: "smoke-suite-id or url"
verification: "automated|manual"
checkpoints: "36h:status, 5d:status, 21d:status"
prevented_by: "brief guardrail"
biz_impact: "low|medium|high"
pm_link: "url"
notes: "optional text"
```

Sofia Martinez: if we require biz_impact and verification, ops-bot can route high-impact items to PMs and kick off a cross-team triage within 72h. good escalation path.

Akash Verma: escalation ladder idea: missed 36h -> owner ping + channel mention; missed 5d -> escalate to tech lead and auto-create follow-up in remediation board; missed 21d regression_check -> create priority backlog ticket and tag for monthly systemic review. ops-bot can automate all steps.

Mira Collins: IC rotation details: 1-week IC shifts with a shadow day on day 6 where outgoing and incoming IC pair for 2 hours to walk through active remediations and verify outstanding checkpoints. include a one-line comms cadence pick at declare: quick options (aggressive: initial/15m/30m/1hr/final, default: initial/30m/hour/final). IC picks and ops-bot pins it.

Noah Rivera: recurring pattern tracking: require a failure_mode tag in every PM block. weekly job aggregates tags and posts a top-5 heatmap to #eng-leads and #product. that will help fund platform-level work instead of repeating quick fixes.

Akash Verma: implementation note: parser should tolerate the block as YAML or JSON-ish key:value lines. prototype will live in infra-tools and produce a CSV for the dashboard. I can take this. timeline: 2 weeks for a basic extractor + weekly report.

Sofia Martinez: I'll write the IC handoff one-pager and the shadow-day checklist. Due: 4 days. Mira will help with verification wording.

Mira Collins: I'll draft the verification matrix (what counts as automated smoke vs manual signoff) and the PM routing rules. Due: 5 days.

ops-bot: Reminder: 36h checkpoint for REM-2024-701 (owner: Noah Rivera) scheduled to post in #eng-oncall at 3100005921.

Noah Rivera: Actions captured: (1) Akash - extractor + weekly heatmap prototype (owner: Akash, due: 14 days). (2) Sofia - IC handoff one-pager + shadow checklist (owner: Sofia, due: 4 days). (3) Mira - verification matrix + PM routing rules (owner: Mira, due: 5 days). (4) Noah - add the parseable block to the current PM and enable 36h reminder (owner: Noah, due: today). Please ack.

Akash Verma: ack, starting on prototype.

Sofia Martinez: ack, drafting now.

Mira Collins: ack, will post a draft tomorrow.

Noah Rivera: thanks team. let's converge in a short follow-up meeting after the first extractor demo. ops-bot will post invites once prototype repo link is shared.

ops-bot: Policy saved: IC shadow-day policy v0.1 and remediation checkpoint ladder v0.3.
